git_revision_note: The receipt ships with the commit it describes, so it cannot contain that commit's own identity. The branch freebuff/windows-test-performance-under-concurrent-load and pull request #199 carry it.
execution_mode: local desktop agent in one dedicated worktree on the shared laboratory VM; only this checkout, its own temporary directories and its private evidence directory were written; no other campaign's worktree, branch, interpreter or process was modified
model_note: Not exposed to agent tools. No paid provider was connected, no credits purchased, no additional AI worker launched, and no runtime was reinstalled globally.

source.detail: The focused regression suite, including a patched provenance query that proves a delayed post-execution source query cannot inflate the suite duration, and temporary repositories whose untracked file contents are rewritten mid-run.

coverage: Measurement-boundary checkpoint only: the suite duration was separated from pre- and post-execution source qualification, untracked file contents were bound to the source identity, and the documentation and public projection were updated. 82 focused tests were executed (79 harness, 3 fixture isolation). No portable suite run, no controlled A/B re-run and no microbenchmark session were performed, by instruction.
attribution_limits: No host measurement is claimed in this checkpoint: the numbers here are test counts, not performance. The historical suite durations are preserved as recorded and are upper bounds on instrumented execution because they included the post-run Git queries. Host CPU, memory and process counts describe a shared VM and are not provider consumption.
status: boundary checkpoint: suite duration now covers instrumented execution only, provenance queries are timed separately, untracked file contents are bound within a fixed budget or reported as an incomplete identity, and historical measurements are preserved with their original limitations
measurement_note: regression_tests_executed is 79 harness tests plus 3 fixture-isolation tests. The zero-valued measurements record that this checkpoint deliberately measured no performance: the two full baseline runs, the controlled fixture A/B and the microbenchmark session from earlier checkpoints are preserved unchanged and were not repeated.
private_evidence: Raw run JSON, host timelines, comparison artifacts and the campaign registry are retained outside Git under the laboratory private-evidence directory; only the harness, the analysis and these reviewed receipts are published. The sanitized projection written by --public-out is the publishable form of a run report.
